subject: Website redesign before the holidays?
body:
Hi there,

I own Bluebird Bakery on 5th Street. Our website is about 8 years old, doesn't work well on phones, and we can't take cake orders online. A friend at Lakeside Yoga recommended you.

We'd love a refresh with online ordering for custom cakes, ideally live before Thanksgiving week. Our budget is somewhere around $4,000-6,000. Could we set up a call this week?

Thanks!
Maria Gonzalez
Owner, Bluebird Bakery
(555) 201-4432
